cases.situation: I'm Nadia. I've emailed Ruth, who owns a local bookstore called Chapter House, twice about hosting a reading of my novel, with no reply in 3 weeks. Before I let it go, I want to leave one short voicemail on the shop's phone. My number is 07700 900456.
cases.reply: Hi Ruth, this is Nadia. I emailed a couple of times about doing a reading of my novel at Chapter House, and I know the shop keeps you busy, so I thought a call might be easier. Is it something you'd consider? A quick yes or no is plenty. I'm on 07700 900456. Thanks.
cases.note: Switching channel once is fine when email gets nothing: name and number, one question, and treat it as the last nudge.

cases.situation: 周六组织同学聚餐，饭店说今晚8点前要确认包间，老王还没回我来不来。
cases.reply: 老王，周六的包间我今晚8点前要跟饭店确认，你来不来？来不来都行，回个字就好。
cases.note: 把回复变得很小，截止时间是为了订位，不是为了催人。

cases.situation: I followed up with my contractor about the kitchen quote and he snapped back 'I saw it, I've been slammed.' I need it by the 20th, or I have to start lining up someone else.
cases.reply: Totally understand. No rush from me before the 20th; after that I'll need to start lining someone up, so a rough date for the quote would help whenever you get a sec.
cases.note: Don't defend the nudge. Take the answer, give room, and state the real planning date once.

cases.situation: I'm Sofia. My former professor, Dr. Hayes, agreed on Sept 8 to write me a recommendation for the Urban Planning MA at Northfield; I took her seminar and did two projects in it. The deadline is Oct 15 and the portal still shows it as not submitted. I already resent the link once on Sept 15.
cases.reply:
Hi Dr. Hayes,
I know the start of term is hectic. A quick note on the recommendation for the Urban Planning MA at Northfield: the portal still shows it as pending, and the deadline is Thursday 15 October. I've pasted the upload link below so you don't have to dig for it. If a short list of the projects I did in your seminar would save you time, I can send it today.
Thank you again,
Sofia
cases.note: Assume busy, restate the thing and the date in one line, and make doing it easier than postponing it. Don't ask whether they're still willing.

cases.situation: 10天前微信问大学室友小敏愿不愿意明年5月当我伴娘，她显示已读但一直没回。她最近刚换工作。礼服得在11月中旬前定。我有点慌，怕她不想又不好意思拒绝。
cases.reply: 小敏，知道你刚换工作肯定忙翻了。上次问你明年5月当伴娘的事，你别有压力，愿意、不方便、还要再想想，哪个答案都完全没问题。11月15日前告诉我一声就行，我好安排礼服。
cases.note: 给她一个体面说“不”的出口，截止时间说成是为了安排礼服，不是催她。

cases.situation: Uni group project, presentation is Thursday at 10am. I asked Ellie in the group chat on Friday and again Sunday for her 4 slides on the survey results. She's read both, no reply. Tom and I are merging the deck tomorrow at 7pm.
cases.reply: Hey Ellie, I know it's a heavy week. Are your 4 survey slides on track? We're merging the deck tomorrow at 7pm. If it's easier, send whatever you have, even rough numbers, and Tom and I will do the formatting.
cases.note: Move from the group chat to a direct message, make the reply tiny, and take work off her plate. If nothing by tomorrow noon, split her slides between you and stop chasing.

cases.situation: My friend Chloe moved to Berlin in June. I've texted her twice since August and she hasn't answered. I don't need anything from her, I just miss her and don't want to sound hurt.
cases.reply: Hey Chloe, no agenda, just thinking of you and wondering how Berlin's treating you. No need for a proper reply, a photo of your street or your favourite bakery would make my week.
cases.note: With a friend, drop the old thread entirely; the follow-up is about her, with a reply so small it costs nothing.

cases.situation: Ich bin Tobias Lange und am 15. September in die Kochstraße 14, 2. OG links, in Leipzig eingezogen. Für die Anmeldung beim Bürgeramt brauche ich die Wohnungsgeberbestätigung; am 18. September habe ich die Hausverwaltung, Frau Krüger, per Mail darum gebeten und keine Antwort bekommen. Mein Termin beim Bürgeramt ist am Donnerstag, 15. Oktober.
cases.reply:
Sehr geehrte Frau Krüger,
ich weiß, dass bei Ihnen gerade viel los ist, und melde mich noch einmal wegen der Wohnungsgeberbestätigung für meine Wohnung Kochstraße 14, 2. OG links, in die ich am 15. September eingezogen bin. Mein Termin beim Bürgeramt ist am Donnerstag, 15. Oktober. Könnten Sie mir die Bestätigung bis dahin per Mail schicken? Ein kurzer Hinweis, bis wann es klappt, hilft mir auch schon.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Tobias Lange
cases.note: Erster Anstoß an eine Verwaltung: das Anliegen in einer Zeile, der echte Termin als Grund für die Frist und eine kleine Antwort (ein Datum) als Ausweg.

cases.situation: 我在做季度经营分析，一周前在钉钉上找财务部的小陈要三季度各区域的退款数据，三天前又提醒过一次，都没回。报告10月12日周一要交，最好10月9日周五前拿到数据。
cases.reply: 小陈，知道季度末你们财务最忙。还是三季度各区域退款数据的事，我的报告10月12日要交，如果10月9日周五前能给我就能赶上；来不及的话，给我一个大概时间也行，我好排进度。实在排不开也没关系，告诉我找谁拿更方便。
cases.note: 第二次提醒：先替对方想到忙，一句话说清要什么，截止时间是为了排期，再留一个体面的出口。

cases.situation: Two weeks ago I messaged Rachel, a former colleague who's now at a payments company, asking for a 20-minute chat about their data team. She said 'sure, ping me next week', I did last Tuesday, and nothing since. I'm free after 11 on Thursday Oct 8 and Friday Oct 9. She's doing me a favour so I don't want to be a pest.
cases.reply: Hi Rachel, I know things get hectic, so one more try on the chat about the data team. Would 20 minutes on Thursday Oct 8 or Friday Oct 9 work, any time after 11? If the next few weeks are packed, a quick 'not now' is completely fine and I'll leave it there.
cases.note: Second bump to someone doing you a favour: two concrete slots and an easy out, because she owes you nothing.

cases.situation: I'm Laura. Six days ago I emailed Maple Hall, a community venue, asking if Saturday 14 November is free for my daughter's 10th birthday party, 1pm to 4pm. No reply yet, and I'd like to send invitations next week.
cases.reply: Hi, bumping this in case it got buried: is the hall free on Saturday 14 November, 1pm to 4pm, for a children's birthday party? A quick yes or no is all I need for now, and I can sort the booking details after. Thanks, Laura
cases.note: First bump to a busy inbox: lightest touch, the whole question in one line, and a yes or no is enough.

cases.situation: I make engraved dog collars. A customer, Megan, ordered one last week, and four days ago I emailed to check the engraving 'Biscuit 07700 90012' because the number looked one digit short. No reply, and I can't make it until she confirms.
cases.reply: Hi Megan, I know inboxes pile up. A quick check before I engrave Biscuit's collar: the phone number reads 07700 90012, which looks one digit short. Could you send the full number, or reply 'as is' if that's right? I'll make it the same day I hear back.
cases.note: Following up with your own customer: the reason is theirs (a correct tag), the reply is one line, and there's no pressure beyond the real wait.

cases.situation: 我在小区二手群里卖婴儿推车，300元。邻居刘姐说想要，约好周六来看，之后我发了两次消息确认时间，她都没回。还有另一位邻居也在问。
cases.reply: 刘姐，知道带娃事多。推车还给您留着，周六您大概几点方便过来看？要是不需要了也完全没关系，回我一句就行，另一位邻居也在问，我好跟她说。
cases.note: 另一位邻居在问是真实情况，只说一次，当作安排信息而不是催促；她说不要了就痛快转给别人。

cases.situation: In my review on Sept 3, my manager Karen said she'd put me forward for the senior analyst promotion and get back to me 'in a couple of weeks'. It's been four weeks and I mentioned it once in passing on the 17th. I led the Q3 pricing work. I don't want to seem pushy with my own boss. Slack DM.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, I know quarter-end is busy. A quick one on the senior analyst promotion we talked about in my review on 3 September: is there an update, or a rough date when you expect to hear? Even 'still in progress' is useful. If it would help, I can put together a one-page summary of my Q3 pricing work by Wednesday 7 October.
cases.note: With your own manager, ask about timing rather than commitment, and offer something that makes her case easier to push through.

cases.situation: The heating in my flat stopped working on Sept 21. I texted my landlord, Mr. Doyle, about my flat at 12 Carlow Road that day and he said he'd send someone 'this week'. Nobody came, I nudged on Sept 26 and got no reply. Nights are dropping to about 4°C. I'm home Monday 5 and Tuesday 6 October, and my neighbour at number 14 can hold a key.
cases.reply: Hi Mr. Doyle, I know you've got a lot on. Following up on the heating at 12 Carlow Road, which has been off since 21 September; nights are getting close to freezing now. Could you let me know which day your engineer can come? I'm home all day Monday 5 and Tuesday 6 October, or I can leave a key with the neighbour at number 14.
cases.note: Second bump: the date it started, a one-word reply (a day), and access made easy. Keep the texts; if this gets nothing, check your lease and local tenant advice on repairs.

cases.situation: 表妹小雨让我帮她改简历，我5天前在微信上把改好的文档发给她了，她一直没回。我不确定她是收到了没空看，还是文件没打开。
cases.reply: 小雨，简历改好的版本收到了吗？要是打不开，我转成PDF再发你一份。不急着看，回个“收到”就行。
cases.note: 对方要的东西发出后的跟进：问收没收到、主动给替代格式，不问“看了没”，不给压力。

cases.situation: 我是儿子班上的家委会成员。9月23日在家长群发了放学护导的接龙：10月9日起每周五下午3:30到4:00在校门口，一共要排12位家长，到现在只有2位接了。排班表得在10月7日前交给班主任。
cases.reply: 各位家长好，知道这阵子大家都忙，趁国庆假期再提一下护导接龙。10月9日起每周五下午3:30到4:00，在校门口站半小时就行。方便的直接在接龙里填名字和想排的日期；这学期排不开的，私信我一句“不行”也很有帮助。我10月7日前要把排班表交给班主任，谢谢大家！
cases.note: 群里跟进不点名、不数谁没接，给“不行”留个出口，比催促更能让人动。

cases.situation: Last Thursday I asked my brother Kieran on WhatsApp whether he can drive Dad to his eye appointment on Wednesday Oct 14 at 2pm, because I'm working that day. He read it and hasn't replied. If I don't know by Friday Oct 9, I'll book Dad a taxi instead.
cases.reply: Hey Kieran, I know work's full on right now. Can you take Dad to his eye appointment on Wednesday 14 October at 2pm? A yes or no is all I need. If I haven't heard by Friday 9 October, I'll book him a taxi, no hard feelings either way.
cases.note: Between siblings, skip the guilt about who does more: one line, a yes or no, and the fallback said out loud so silence still gets Dad there.

cases.situation: I had a blood test at my GP surgery on Sept 16 because I've been very tired. When I called on Sept 25, reception said a doctor would ring me about the results, and nobody has. I want to send a message through the surgery's online form. I'm Anna Kowalski, and I can take calls on 07700 900123 weekdays after 1pm.
cases.reply: Hello, this is Anna Kowalski following up on my blood test from 16 September. When I called on 25 September I was told a doctor would ring me about the results, and I haven't had a call yet. Could someone let me know whether the results are back and if I need an appointment? I'm on 07700 900123 on weekdays after 1pm.
cases.note: Health: if symptoms get worse, call the surgery rather than wait on the form, and call emergency services if it feels urgent.

cases.situation: 我在找工作，9月18号微信问以前的同事阿杰能不能帮我内推他们公司的产品经理岗位，上周二又跟进了一次。今天他回：“不好意思，部门最近冻结招聘了，帮不上忙。”
cases.reply: 明白，谢谢你特意回我，还把情况说清楚了。你先忙，以后有机会再聊。
cases.note: 跟进换来一个“不行”也是结果：一句谢谢就收，不追问，也不顺势请他帮别的忙。

cases.situation: I'm Sam. My accountant, Helen, said on Sept 10 she'd send my draft self-employed accounts by Sept 18. I emailed on Sept 22 asking for an update and heard nothing. She told me the filing deadline is Oct 31, I'm away Oct 19 to 25, and I want time to review them before then.
cases.reply:
Hi Helen, I know this is a busy season for you. Following up on my draft accounts, which we'd planned for 18 September. Could you let me know roughly when they'll be ready? I'm away 19 to 25 October, so having them by Friday 16 October would give me time to go through them before the 31 October deadline. Even a rough date helps me plan.
Thanks,
Sam
cases.note: Second bump to someone you pay: the date you need is about your planning, and a rough date is enough of a reply.

cases.situation: Minha irmã Carla precisa assinar a procuração para vendermos o apartamento da nossa mãe. Mandei o documento por WhatsApp em 15 de setembro e lembrei em 23 de setembro; ela visualizou e não respondeu. O cartório marcou para 14 de outubro e preciso da procuração assinada até 9 de outubro.
cases.reply: Oi, Carla, sei que essas semanas andam corridas. Sobre a procuração do apartamento da mamãe: o cartório marcou para 14 de outubro, então preciso dela assinada até sexta, 9 de outubro. Dá para você assinar até lá? Se tiver alguma dúvida sobre o documento ou preferir conversar antes de assinar, me fala, sem problema nenhum.
cases.note: O silêncio da família sobre papelada pode ser hesitação, não falta de tempo; oferecer uma conversa dá a ela um jeito de dizer isso.

cases.situation: We fly to Porto and land at 11pm on Saturday 10 October, so we'd reach our rental flat around midnight. Five days ago I asked the host, Ana, through the booking app whether self check-in works that late; she's read it but not replied. If it doesn't, we'll book a hotel for the first night, and I'd like it sorted by Tuesday 6 October.
cases.reply: Hi Ana, I know you get a lot of messages, so re-asking in one line: we land at 11pm on Saturday 10 October and would reach the flat around midnight. Is self check-in possible that late? A quick yes or no is perfect; if it's a no, we'll book a hotel for the first night, so either answer helps.
cases.note: Restate the question so she doesn't scroll, and say a no is useful so it's easy to answer.

cases.situation: I'm the dad of Grace, 20, who's in her second year at university in Glasgow. I texted her nine days ago asking how her new flat is going, and again on Sunday; she's read both but not replied. She's told me before that lectures pile up in October, and I don't want to nag, I just want to know she's okay.
cases.reply: Hi love, I know October gets busy with lectures. No need for a proper reply, just a thumbs-up so I know you're okay. Tell me about the flat whenever you've got time. Love, Dad
cases.note: From a parent, drop the original question and ask for the smallest reply; if silence goes on and you're worried for her safety, call her or someone near her rather than texting again.

cases.situation: My friend Callum borrowed my tent for a festival in August. I texted him on 24 September asking if I could have it back; he read it and hasn't replied. I need it for a camping trip leaving Friday 16 October, and I can pick it up from his place Monday or Wednesday evening next week.
cases.reply: Hey Callum, I know things get busy. Quick one on the tent: I need it for a camping trip leaving Friday 16 October. I can swing by yours to grab it, would Monday or Wednesday evening suit?
cases.note: Second nudge about your own item: the date you need it, the pickup made easy, and no guilt about the silence.

cases.situation: 我家和隔壁赵叔家中间的院墙裂了一道缝，师傅看过，报价2400元。9月24日我在微信上问赵叔愿不愿意一家一半，他到现在没回。师傅说10月10日前定下来，月中就能来修。
cases.reply: 赵叔，知道您这阵子忙。还是院墙那道裂缝的事：师傅报价2400元，我想的是两家一人一半。师傅要10月10日前定档期，您看是这个月修，还是等过阵子再说？哪个都行，回我一句我好跟师傅说。
cases.note: 第一次跟进：一句话重说事情，给两个好选的答案；他的沉默不等于同意，没回之前别替他定下来。

cases.situation: I missed my friend Leah's first gallery opening on Sept 19 because I got the date wrong, and on Sept 21 I texted her a real apology. She's read it but hasn't replied in 10 days. I don't want to pressure her, but I don't want her to think I've just moved on.
cases.reply: Hey Leah, no need to reply to this. I meant every word of my message about missing your opening, and I'm here whenever you feel like talking. I'd still love to see the work.
cases.note: After an apology, the follow-up asks for nothing and goes once; then let her come to you.

cases.situation: I'm Priya. I sent my co-author, Dr. Tom Lund, our final manuscript on Sept 18 and nudged him by email on Sept 25, with no reply either time. The special issue deadline is Oct 15, and before I submit I need his sign-off on the author order and on the methods section he wrote. He's teaching a new course this term.
cases.reply:
Hi Tom, I know the new course is eating your term. Checking in on the final manuscript for the special issue: I need your sign-off on the author order and your methods section by Friday 9 October so I can submit before the 15 October deadline. If you're happy with both as they stand, a one-line 'approved' is all I need, and if you'd like changes, just tell me which parts.
Thanks,
Priya
cases.note: Bump 2 with a reason and a tiny reply; silence is not sign-off, so if nothing comes by the 9th, phone him or ask the editor about an extension.

cases.situation: 営業部の中村です。9月24日に、法務部の先輩の高橋さんへ、新しい取引先との業務委託契約書のチェックを社内チャットでお願いしましたが、既読のまま返事がありません。先方への返送期限が10月9日（金）なので、10月7日（水）までに見てもらえると助かります。
cases.reply: 高橋さん、お疲れさまです。営業部の中村です。お忙しいところすみません、9月24日にお願いした業務委託契約書のチェックの件で改めてご連絡しました。先方への返送期限が10月9日（金）のため、10月7日（水）までに見ていただけると大変助かります。もし難しそうでしたら、どなたに相談すればよいか教えていただくだけでも十分です。
cases.note: 社内の先輩への2回目の連絡は、忙しさへの配慮、用件を一行で、期限の理由、そして断りやすい出口をセットにする。

cases.situation: I manage a small analytics team. On Monday I asked Kenji, who joined in July and is quite reserved, on Slack whether he'd like to present his churn dashboard at the all-hands on Thursday 15 October; he read it but hasn't replied. I need to send the organiser the speaker list by Friday 9 October, and I don't want him to feel he has to say yes because I'm his manager.
cases.reply: Hi Kenji, picking up my message from Monday about presenting your churn dashboard at the all-hands on 15 October. It's genuinely optional, and 'not this time' is a completely fine answer. I need to send the speaker list by Friday 9 October, so a yes or no by Thursday 8 October would help me plan.
cases.note: From a manager, make the no as easy as the yes; if he still doesn't answer, leave him off the list rather than reading the silence as a yes.

cases.situation: 我9月15日从上家公司离职，新公司要我10月12日入职前交离职证明，说扫描件也行。9月21日和9月27日我在微信上问了前公司的HR林姐，她都没回。
cases.reply: 林姐好，再打扰一下。我的离职证明新公司要求10月12日入职前交，扫描件就可以。您方便告诉我大概哪天能开吗？如果需要我补什么材料，说一声我马上发。
cases.note: 第二次跟进，只问一个日期；还没回就换渠道，打人事部座机或请原部门领导帮忙问。

cases.situation: 我在做一档聊返乡青年的播客。9月10日和9月20日两次在微信上邀请老同学阿哲来当嘉宾，聊他回老家开民宿的事，他两次都没回。想发最后一条，之后就不再打扰了。
cases.reply: 阿哲，最后打扰一次播客的事。我就当这阵子时间不合适，不再催你了。以后哪天想聊聊开民宿这几年，随时找我。
cases.note: 第三次也是最后一次：自己把这件事收尾，留一个以后的口子；之后他还不回，就不再发了。

cases.situation: I'm Daniel Reyes. On Sept 8 I filed a home insurance claim with Harbourline Insurance for a burst pipe that ruined my hallway floor, claim number HL-48213. The handler, Ms Okafor, emailed on Sept 14 that an assessor would contact me within 10 working days; nobody has, and my email on Sept 25 got no reply. I'm free for a visit any weekday after 3pm.
cases.reply:
Hi Ms Okafor,
I know claims teams are stretched. Following up on claim HL-48213, the burst pipe and hallway floor, filed on 8 September. Your email of 14 September said an assessor would be in touch within 10 working days, and I haven't heard from anyone yet. Could you give me a date for the visit, or the assessor's contact details so I can arrange it directly? I'm free any weekday after 3pm.
Thanks,
Daniel Reyes
cases.note: Claim number in the first line, dates of each contact, and two easy ways to answer; if this gets nothing, ask how to raise a complaint under the policy.
